findings.evidence: grep `theorem (contMDiff_laplaceBeltrami|continuous_laplaceBeltrami)` finds only `contMDiff_laplaceBeltrami` at Laplacian.lean:262; no continuity corollary exists.
findings.fix: Add `continuous_laplaceBeltrami_of_contMDiff_two (hu : ContMDiff I 𝓘(ℝ) 2 u) : Continuous (laplaceBeltrami I u)` to `Laplacian.lean` and use it at all three places.
findings.issue: `(contMDiff_laplaceBeltrami (n := 0) (m := ∞) (k := 1) (by simp) (by simp) (by simpa using hu)).continuous` is written out three times (here, ~411 in `forall_hasDerivAt_liouvilleEnergy_add_smul_iff`, ~480 in `liouvilleEnergy_le_of_neg_laplaceBeltrami_add_add_exp_eq_zero`). The reusable fact that a C² function has a continuous Laplacian is never stated.

findings.evidence: grep `toIsContMDiffZero|IsManifold I \(0 \+ 1\) M` hits LiouvilleEnergy.lean:134,136,200,202,237,239,461,463 and Poincare.lean:216,218. `continuous_inner_mgradient` (Gradient/Basic.lean:312) requires `[IsContMDiffRiemannianBundle I 0 E _]`.
findings.fix: Add public `continuous_inner_mgradient` and `continuous_norm_mgradient` variants to Gradient/Basic.lean that take `[IsContinuousRiemannianBundle E _]`. Use them in both files and delete the five copies of the workaround instances.
findings.issue: Each of these sites rebuilds `have : IsManifold I (0 + 1) M := by simpa …` and `have : IsContMDiffRiemannianBundle I 0 E … := IsContinuousRiemannianBundle.toIsContMDiffZero`, only so it can call `continuous_inner_mgradient`: lines 134, 200, 237, 461 here and Poincare.lean:216. Poincare.lean:219 also derives continuity of `‖∇u‖` through `.sqrt`/`Real.sqrt_sq`, although this PR adds a private `continuous_norm_sq_mgradient`.

summary: The proofs are readable and avoid undocumented defeq tricks, but the same reasoning is repeated inline instead of factored into reusable lemmas: Laplacian continuity three times and the workaround instances for gradient continuity five times.
